$comment: The billing catalog: what an organization can be on and what each plan unlocks. The app reads it at runtime (src/lib/billing/catalog.ts) and `npm run stripe:sync` creates the Stripe products and prices from it, so this file is the one place a plan is defined. Amounts are in the currency's minor unit (1900 = 19.00). `features` are the strings requireOrgFeature() checks; `free` is what an organization without a subscription gets.

free.name: Free
free.description: For trying things out on your own.

products.name: Pro
products.description: For small teams shipping every week.

products.name: Team
products.description: For organizations with more people and an API to call.
